scope: Fail-closed plaintext policy for gRPC health targets

behavior.loopback_without_ca: Allowed for local development and Compose health checks.
behavior.explicit_private_plaintext: The operator can opt in with --insecure; this flag cannot bypass a configured server-TLS-without-CA error.

data_access.remote_plaintext_attempt: Mocked; verified no channel was opened.

limitations: The remote plaintext rejection and explicit opt-in use mocked channels; the TLS loopback acceptance separately validates local certificate trust.
Production certificate/DNS validation, certificate lifecycle, public ingress, authenticated tenant scope, and REST parity remain open.
